data.heading: Modern Presentation Blocks

items.title: Next-Gen Bento Blueprint
items.content: Combine math equations, flowcharts, video players, and code sandboxes inside responsive grid slots that resize fluidly across tablet, mobile, or widescreen screens.

items.title: Dynamic Loaders
items.content: On-demand CDN fetching only downloads heavy engines (KaTeX, Mermaid, Prism) when needed.

items.title: Glassmorphism
items.content: Sophisticated glass backdrop filters and glowing neon borders that respond cleanly to theme settings.
